name: lyrifind
description: LyriFind - Lyrics Discovery & Management Platform (React + Vite, Tailwind CSS, Node.js + Express, MongoDB + Mongoose)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:embedded: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:embedded --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run build

author: Ankit Kushwaha
